evidence: (1) /app is empty except .gitkeep: task/environment/Dockerfile:16-23 does `mkdir -p /app && git -C /app init ... && touch /app/.gitkeep && git -C /app add .gitkeep && git -C /app commit`; nothing else is written to /app. The Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile (diff empty; sha256 0a75419e...e7d1). (2) Build context is environment/ and contains only Dockerfile, instructions/hireops_rules.md (sha256 dc739547...bd21e), instructions/integration.md (1b56dd3f...352c), assets/seed_data.json (a1c65c80...3740); only lines 14-15 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` and `COPY assets/ /assets/` copy files; no COPY of solution/ or tests/. (3) No starter/skeleton/schema/route list/partial UI: hireops_rules.md:3-5 explicitly says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours'; it states behavioral rules and HTTP status semantics (401/403/404/409, lines 21-23, 78) but no endpoint paths, table DDL, or code. integration.md names only the runtime contract (/app/server.js, port 3000, /api/health, /app/app.db, DB_PATH) which is required public runtime info, and line 14 says 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you.' (4) seed_data.json holds only inputs: keys generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16; one REJECTED with rejected_from/reject_reason), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6). No derived outputs (no activity log, unread counts, card versions, seen marks, expected results). It is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is the expected copy direction (golden copies the input), not an answer leak. (5) Rubric reproduction: grep of instructions and seed for judge|rubric|criteri|reward|score|sentinel|probe|playwright|glm|/tests|expected returned no grader vocabulary (only the word 'answers' in a seed note body and integration.md:9 'answers'). 8-word shingle overlap between /instructions/*.md and every tests/ judge.toml, prompt.md, app_context.md, scoring.toml: zero runs everywhere except scored/functional/judge.toml with two 8-word phrases ('place the reason is shown and keyboard focus', 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in') - these are the public requirement stated in the rules (hireops_rules.md:85, 90) echoed by the criterion, not criterion text or ids leaking into the environment; no criterion ids, dimension names or sentinels appear. Counterexample attempts: a broken app cannot pass by reusing anything in the image because no UI, server, or schema exists there; a conforming alternative (different routes/ids/storage layout) is explicitly permitted by the notes, so the environment does not covertly pin the golden's structure. Not measured: the built agent image was not inspected at runtime (no docker run per assignment constraints); the verdict rests on the static Dockerfile and build context, which fully determine image contents beyond the pinned base image and global npm packages.
